From 150 kg to Cycling Across Europe: My Sleeve Gastrectomy Journey & Transformation

By: KARIM SAAB (Abdulkarim bin Ibrahim Al-Saab)

Major life transformations begin the moment a person makes a sincere decision to change. That turning point defined my personal journey—moving from weighing 150 kilograms to conquering long-distance cycling adventures across the globe [00:00:12, 00:04:24].

Breaking the Cycle of Temporary Diets

For years, I experimented with every imaginable diet—from conventional meal plans to strict chemical regimens—in pursuit of reclaiming my health [00:00:23]. While each attempt yielded temporary weight loss, a single trip or social gathering was enough to undo months of effort, bringing the weight back even faster [00:00:44]. It became clear that short-term fixes were no longer the answer; I needed a decisive, sustainable medical intervention.

Choosing Gastric Sleeve: Understanding How It Works

After weighing surgical options such as gastric bypass versus sleeve gastrectomy—and conducting thorough research alongside medical guidance—I chose to undergo sleeve gastrectomy [00:01:10].

Far from the exaggerated fears surrounding it, the procedure straightforwardly reduces stomach capacity while removing the portion responsible for secreting the hunger hormone (ghrelin)—a mechanism I liken to the "float valve" in a water tank that regulates fullness [00:02:08]. Once removed, relentless hunger subsides, making portion control natural and manageable.

Post-Op Discipline & Cycling Across Europe

Surgery alone is never a magic wand; it is a powerful tool that succeeds through awareness and commitment [00:03:23]. By adhering to medical follow-ups, taking essential vitamins, and prioritizing nutrient-dense foods like fresh salads and vegetables, recovery was smooth and free of complications [00:04:53].

The ultimate proof of the procedure's safety and vitality—even at the age of fifty—is my ability, by the grace of God, to embrace endurance sports and embark on long-distance bicycle touring across Europe with strength and stamina [00:04:24, 00:04:42]. This transformative chapter later inspired my published book, "I Was 150 kg" (كنت 150 كجم).

Personal Reflection:
"Our bodies are a trust from God, given to us so we may worship Him and live productively in good health and well-being. For me, choosing sleeve gastrectomy was never merely about losing weight—it was a gateway to an active, purposeful life. May God grant us all health, sincerity, and success." [00:05:04]
